title: noise#01.aif by huubjeroen
author: huubjeroen
sourceDescription: Couple of minutes of soccer/crowd noise at a feyenoord game, the kuip stadium in rotterdam, netherlands. This was mixed for t.v. broadcast and quickly recorded to the line in of my macbook. Neumann km 140 mics for crowd noise, sennheiser 416p's at the pitch, into a lawo mc66/2 desk. Stereo, dolby pro logic II encoded.
modifications: cut 154.99-169.99s window; mono 22050 Hz; MP3 48 kbps; peak gain +0.00 dB (peak -5.20 dBFS); 30 ms fades
